chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār narrated from Aḥmad ibn Ḥamzah, who said:
I said to him: Indeed, in our town, wealth is sometimes bequeathed to the family of Muḥammad, so they bring it to me, and I dislike bringing it to you until I seek your permission.
So he said: “Do not bring it to me, and do not involve yourself with it.”

key_terms.لَا تَأْتِنِي بِهِ: do not bring it to me
key_terms.لَا تَتَعَرَّضْ لَهُ: do not involve yourself with it
key_terms.لِآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: for the family of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What did the Imam عليه السلام instruct regarding wealth bequeathed to Āl Muḥammad?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a case involving wealth bequeathed to Āl Muḥammad. The Imam عليه السلام instructs the questioner neither to bring such property to him nor to involve himself in it, indicating a legal directive of non-interference in this case.
